description: Returns the current year's leave balances for the authenticated user (or a specified employee). Shows Annual, Sick, and Personal leave entitlement, used days, and remaining balance. Use when the user asks 'how much leave do I have?', 'what is my leave balance?', 'how many sick days do I have left?'. Requires TimeOffManagement feature.

user_id.description: Target employee UUID. Defaults to the authenticated user. Manager+ can query team members.

name: get_leave_balance

balances.description: Array of leave balance objects (leaveType, totalEntitlement, usedDays, remainingDays, year)

user_id.description: Employee UUID the balances are for

title: Leave Balance
